content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I'd like to program a 'day shifter' in my [product_name] to display in [product_name]. Is it possible to create a shift register for this purpose? I want to show specific weekday names (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, etc.) instead of generic day offsets like -1 day, -2 day, and so on. After midnight, the days should rotate. I've attached an example that should clarify my intent, but if anything is unclear, please let me know. Kind regards [user_name]

I offered a solution in another topic: temperature shift for 7 days. You just need to transfer the value to the VM memory via Parameter-VM-Mapping. Navigate to Tools > Parameter-VM-Mapping Alternatively, you could use analog flags (AMx) to display the shifted value in the extended web server.

Good afternoon [user_name], Your previous solution worked well for displaying daily values, but my current question involves shifting 'text.' Specifically, I want to shift the label "Monday" into the next block, "Tuesday" into the following block, and so on. I've added a new screenshot for clarity. Thank you for your patience. Kind regards [user_name]

I don't see a way to achieve this directly. You can use the weekly timer to determine the current day of the week as a numeric value. With this, you could stack seven text fields and only display the corresponding text when the day number matches. However, identifying days prior to the current one is rather cumbersome and I haven't attempted it myself.
[user_name], That's an honest and straightforward answer. Thank you for your time and effort. Kind regards [user_name]
I've attached an example that shows the current weekday in the extended web server.

analysis.insight_summary: A user aims to create a rotating weekday text display within [product_name], preferring to shift full weekday names (e.g., Monday, Tuesday) rather than numeric indicators. Community responses focus on value shifting rather than text, suggesting workarounds that may not be straightforward. There is consensus that shifting weekday names as text is not directly supported in this environment, resulting in a less user-friendly design for those who require text-based rotation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a simple method to rotate or display weekday labels as text in the visualization, similar to how numeric values are shifted or mapped in [product_name].
